CommandText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Site Code'[Site Code.Site Code Level 01.UniqueName],
			'Site Code'[Site Code Level 01],
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month.Cal. year / month Level 01.UniqueName],
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month Level 01],
			"CM3___PLANT_CONTRIBUTION_Actual_YTD", 'Key Figures'[CM3 - PLANT CONTRIBUTION Actual YTD]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			201,
			SUMMARIZE(
				__DS0Core,
				'Site Code'[Site Code.Site Code Level 01.UniqueName],
				'Site Code'[Site Code Level 01]
			),
			'Site Code'[Site Code.Site Code Level 01.UniqueName],
			1,
			'Site Code'[Site Code Level 01],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(
			__DS0Core,
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month.Cal. year / month Level 01.UniqueName],
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month Level 01]
		)

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(
			62,
			__DS0SecondaryBase,
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month.Cal. year / month Level 01.UniqueName],
			1,
			'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month Level 01],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month.Cal. year / month Level 01.UniqueName],
				ASC,
				'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month Level 01],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month.Cal. year / month Level 01.UniqueName],
	'Cal. year / month'[Cal. year / month Level 01]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Site Code'[Site Code.Site Code Level 01.UniqueName],
	'Site Code'[Site Code Level 01],
	[ColumnIndex]
